about: D.A.V. Post Graduate College was established in 1938 by its mother institution, Arya Vidya Sabha, Kashi, as an Intermediate college recognised by Banaras Hindu University, obtaining degree status in 1947 and permanent affiliation in 1954. According to the official history, it commenced undergraduate courses in the faculties of Arts, Social Sciences and Commerce, with Ph.D. and Post Graduate courses added from 2008. It is admitted to the privileges of Banaras Hindu University and is NAAC accredited. The college runs regular undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in Arts, Social Sciences and Commerce plus a range of diploma and add-on courses.
